text:
noah: Quick sync  planning a guarded rollout for `feature:session-cache-opt` in asia-south. Window: 04:15 UTC. Aim: reduce mem pressure without regressing latency.

emma: Can we do micro-steps? 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% -> 25% with 3m holds for first two, 7m for next, 12m final. Auto-rollback if p99>500ms or error spike +0.6%.

noah: Yes. Also pin service version `cache-optimizer@1.4.0` for the cohort to avoid mixed behavior. Rollout payload below.

noah: ```json
{"strategy":"micro-staged","steps":[{"pct":0.5,"hold":"3m"},{"pct":2,"hold":"3m"},{"pct":8,"hold":"7m"},{"pct":25,"hold":"12m"}],"pin":"cache-optimizer@1.4.0","rollback_on":["p99>500","err_delta>0.6"]}
```

piotr: Recommend enabling `session-cache.prefetch=true` for cohort and a short preload 8m before start to warm hot-keys. Also set `X-Debug-Trace: cohort` header for first two steps.

ops-bot: Preload scheduled: `session-preload/asia-cache` at 2026-04-06T04:07:00Z. Will report when done. Infra checks OK: mem headroom and no node restarts in last 24h.

deploy-bot: Rollout queued: `ffctl apply session-cache-opt --env=asia-south` Job: r-77422. ETA 2026-04-06T04:15:00Z. It will annotate the release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/session-cache-opt-2026-04-06.

emma: I'll watch perf dashboard. Alerts: p95>220ms, p99>480ms, errors +0.5% delta. I'll post metric snapshots at each holdpoint.

piotr: If auto-backoff occurs, prefer stepping down to previous stable pct and extend hold +10m. Manual rollback owner: oncall (piotr). PM only notified for >40% traffic.

deploy-bot: Auto-backoff policy enforced. On first auto-backoff will attempt one reconfigure attempt (drain unhealthy hosts) then resume to same step; if resumed step fails again, escalate to oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/micro-ff-backoff


oncall-bot: Current oncall piotr. Will page on escalation.

noah: Small release note blurb for engineering: "Enables session cache prefetch and optimized eviction ladder for mem savings. Pinned to cache-optimizer@1.4.0 for cohort. Fallback: cache disabled on error." I'll add to release link.

piotr: Add `telemetry: cohort-tag=true` so traces and billing attribution are easier. Also capture cold-miss rates and eviction counts.

emma: Good. Final checklist: pin version, set micro-steps JSON, schedule preload, enable headers/traces, set alerts, confirm oncall. Starting in ~10m. I'll heartbeat every holdpoint.

noah: Thanks. If anything odd, we do manual rollback and gather traces for postmortem.
